svg.title: Ukubona pentadic pipeline — five sovereign layers
svg.desc: Five-layer pipeline: large data source, combinatorial explosion, epochal curation, optimization goal, RLS/JWT restricted dashboard.

g.text: field sensors · market ticks · fleet telemetry · journal entries · JWT auth logs
append-only NDJSON · real-world + simulated enter the same store

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do real-world field sensors feed the event store?')
sendPrompt('How does the adversarial simulator generate events?')
sendPrompt('What kinds of events can be manually injected via POST /events?')

g.text: Matrix M — agent × signal × layer cross-product
62 agents × 10 predictors × 5 layers × 5 adversary types = O(n⁴) event space
FastAPI ingestion · POST /events validates & normalises every branch
Jacobian ∂outcome/∂signal computed across full cross-product each tick
SSE stream fans out raw — no filtering yet
Vector V — epoch compressor (this is the bottleneck by design)
multi-epoch adversarial training loop selects signal from noise

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does adversarial training select which events matter?')
sendPrompt('What does the Jacobian eigenmode tell us about which signals survive curation?')
sendPrompt('How does the LLM narrative layer work during epochal curation?')
sendPrompt('How does the SGD update write the curated epoch record?')
g.text: SGD update → θ_t+1 written to NDJSON (epoch record is the curated artefact)
γ|ε_FGT|² penalises deviation from federated ground truth

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does pedigree integrity measure and how is it optimised?')
sendPrompt('What is embodied resonance as an optimization target?')
sendPrompt('What does eigenmode stability mean as an optimization goal?')
sendPrompt('What is legacy impact and why is it the final kingdomonic score?')

g.text: JWT bearer token · row-level security on event store · clearance 1–10 governs visible rows
T1 exec sees all layers · T5 frontline sees own events only · GET /events/stream respects RLS
React/Vite or standalone index.html — dashboard polls SSE, renders Jacobian + scores
